lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is widest in the anterior torso region and narrows progressively toward the posterior haunches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 6th vertical line (counting from the shoulder) in the dorsal-medial quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most lines (8, 9, and 10) are discontinuous, terminating as abbreviated segments or dashed blobs before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, localized above the white hind-leg marking.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower flank align to form a semi-horizontal geometric row beneath the termination points of the 4th through 7th vertical lines.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns emerge at a ~45-degree angle from the skull, curving laterally then medially toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the visible horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch or indentation visible on the inferior margin of the right ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron spanning the bridge of the muzzle; high-contrast white transverse bands on the distal limbs positioned above the orange-tan leg sections.
